A great find in Sa Pa
Jan 2026 • Couples
We stayed in Sapa for four nights and came across BiBi Express, it was busy and the food looked great so we tried it out. 
We had gorgeous coffees and ended up going back there for take away pizzas after a long busy day oh trekking. 

We also had lunch here on one of the days, and went back multiple times for their gorgeous coconut coffee! 

Sung & Linda were absolutely lovely and so friendly.

A place to add to your list of visiting Sapa.
